text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens and be in good health. 2. High school graduation. 3. HSK level 4 or above. 4. The CSCA includes four subjects: Professional Chinese, Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. (1) Professional Chinese Professional Chinese provides two types of tests: Humanities Chinese and Science Chinese. Applicants for majors related to literature, economics, management, law, philosophy, education, and arts should take the test for humanities; Applicants for majors related to sciences, engineering, agriculture, and medicine should take the test for science subjects.Applicants who apply for the major of Chinese Language can be exempted from taking the Professional Chinese test if they can provide a valid HSK Transcript(level 4 at least). (2) Mathematics Mathematics exams are mandatory for all majors. (3) Physics and Chemistry Applicants for majors in science, engineering, agriculture, and medicine should take Physics and Chemistry tests.
